description: This file defines a SwiftUI component 'ScreenWebView' that embeds a WKWebView within the SwiftUI view hierarchy. It manages the creation, updating, and teardown of the web view, including setting up navigation delegate, message handlers, and configuring the web view with shared content. The file also contains a coordinator class to handle interactions between SwiftUI and WebKit, and manages deep link interception and communication between JavaScript and native code.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinator class bridging SwiftUI and WebKit, managing the WKWebView instance, its delegate, and message handlers, as well as handling setup, updates, and teardown.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: Navigation delegate handling deep link interception ('openclaw://' scheme) and navigation events such as finish or fail, communicating back to the ScreenController.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: Message handler for receiving JavaScript messages from the web view, passing validated actions back to the ScreenController.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the container UIView holding the WKWebView, configures constraints, and attaches the WebView to the hierarchy.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and manages attaching/detaching the web view in response to controller changes.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up references, removes message handlers and delegate, and detaches the web view.

methods.name: makeWebView
methods.description: Creates and configures a WKWebView with non-persistent data store and specific UI settings.

methods.name: installA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Adds JavaScript message handlers to the web view's user content controller.

methods.name: removeA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Removes JavaScript message handlers from the user content controller.
